title: The Arizona National Guard Aids in Tourist Evacuation
description: The Arizona Department of Emergency and Military Affairs provided UH-60 Blackhawk helicopter support to evacuate 104 tourist and tribal members out of a canyon after flood waters impacted the Havasupai community and tourists visiting the Havasupai Falls. (U.S. Army video by Maj. Erin Hannigan)
credit: U.S. Army video by Maj. Erin Hannigan
